Description
Tests the effects of NV097_SET_SURFACE_FORMAT_ANTI_ALIASING in various scenarios.
Many of these tests were created to demonstrate specific bugs in xemu and are not of practical value in typical hardware use cases.
Suite class def
src/tests/antialiasing_tests.h

AAOnThenOffCPUWrite

Configure the framebuffer surface with some antialiasing mode, clear, change the mode, modify the framebuffer by writing directly to VRAM, then render. Used to reproduce xemu-project/xemu#652.

CompositeBlurCenter1

As CompositeCenter1, but the composite uses four vertically offset taps (-3, -1, +1, +3 texels) weighted by combiner constants (0x2A, 0x55, 0x55, 0x2A) as done by Rugby 2005's depth of field effect. The composite should be a slightly vertically blurred version of the source.

CompositeBlurCenterCorner2

As CompositeCenterCorner2, but with the four tap vertical blur described in CompositeBlurCenter1. This most closely replicates Rugby 2005 (xemu-project/xemu#2388). The composite should be a slightly vertically blurred version of the source, filling the entire 256x256 target.

CompositeBlurSquareOffset4

As CompositeSquareOffset4, but with the four tap vertical blur described in CompositeBlurCenter1.

CompositeCenter1

Renders a 256x192 surface with NV097_SET_SURFACE_FORMAT_ANTI_ALIASING_CENTER_1, then samples it as a linear texture whose image rect matches the surface pitch to draw a full screen quad into a 256x256 swizzled surface. The left side of the screen shows the source surface, the right side shows the swizzled composite at 1:1. The composite should contain the entire source image stretched to fill the 256x256 target. This is the non-antialiased control case.

CompositeCenterCorner2

As CompositeCenter1, but the source uses NV097_SET_SURFACE_FORMAT_ANTI_ALIASING_CENTER_CORNER_2, so the backing surface (and texture image rect) is 512x192. The composite should contain the entire source image (all 8 bars and the full arrow) stretched to fill the 256x256 target, just as in CompositeCenter1.

CompositeSquareOffset4

As CompositeCenter1, but the source uses NV097_SET_SURFACE_FORMAT_ANTI_ALIASING_SQUARE_OFFSET_4, so the backing surface (and texture image rect) is 512x384. The composite should contain the entire source image stretched to fill the 256x256 target.

CPUWriteIgnoresSurfaceConfig

This test verifies that direct writes to VRAM bypass any surface configuration. It sets up a texture surface with antialiasing enabled, then writes directly to texture memory and renders the texture to the screen. It is expected that antialiasing has no effect.
